PATI SI BANTAY NAKIKIPAGSABAYAN SA HOLIDAY RUSH?

Ibinahagi ng isang netizen ang video kung saan makikitang ini-escort ng isang personnel ng Tactical Motorcycle Rider (TMR) Unit ng Makati City Police Station ang isang stray dog na naligaw sa isang skyway nitong Biyernes, Dec. 26.

Makikita sa video na inaalalayan ng patrol personnel ang aso upang hindi ito magdulot ng aksidente at makalabas ng maayos sa kalsada.

data.cleaned_text: [10:16AM] #Idunmota #Adeniji #TrafficUpdate The stretch of Adeniji Adele road through Oba's palace down to Police post is looking good this morning. Ilubinrin connecting Carter bridge inward Ijora Olopa as well as Oyingbo enroute Eko bridge is moving at a faster speed as there are no hindrances. Idumota underneath the bridge inward Eyin Eyo connecting Balogun street is good as expected. The fallen debris from the burnt building(Great Nigeria House) still spreads on the entire road on Martins Street, hence movement from Ereko street to connect Martins Street is totally restricted. Tinubu square connecting Nnamdi Azikiwe street enroute Carter bridge on the return journey is good to go aside market activities along the corridor. Meanwhile, our traffic personnel are strategically positioned to ensure seamless traffic flow. #FollowLASTMA
